messages.subject: Founder representation plot
parts:
Hi there. 
I would like to plot the founder representation in my DO cohort, similar to the graph in Fig 5B in Svenson et al (2012, Genetics, PMID: 22345611).
Is there a function for this in R/qtl2? In addition I would like to determine the level of heterozygosity at the SNP level and wonder what function to use for this? I used 'calc_het()' to determine this based on the founder haplotype.
Sorry if these are simple or stupid questions, I am fairly new to both R and qtl analysis.
Kind regards
Jacky

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Founder representation plot
parts:
Use calc_geno_freq() to get genotype or allele frequencies. Use plot_scan1() to plot them.
Here's an example.

   doex <- read_cross2("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rqtl/qtl2data/master/DOex/DOex.zip")
   pr <- calc_genoprob(doex, error_prob=0.002, map_function="c-f", cores=0)
   apr <- genoprob_to_alleleprob(pr)
   af <- calc_geno_freq(apr, "marker", omit_x=FALSE)
   par(mfrow=c(8,1), mar=c(2.1, 4.1, 0.6, 0.6))
   ymax <- max(af)
   for(i in 1:8) plot_scan1(af, doex$pmap, lod=i, ylab=colnames(af)[i], ylim=c(0, ymax))

To get heterozygosities of the raw SNP genotypes, there's a function calc_raw_het() in the development version of R/qtl2.
You can get access to it by sourcing the github file:

   source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rqtl/qtl2/master/R/calc_raw_summaries.R")
   snphet <- calc_raw_het(doex, "marker")

You can plot the results with plot_scan1(), but you need to convert it to a matrix, for example with cbind():

   plot_scan1( cbind(snphet), doex$pmap)

karl
